weekLabel: Week of Jul 20-26 · refreshed Sun Jul 19. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: Lowell Folk Festival
events.meta: Free · Downtown Lowell (JFK Plaza + Boarding House Park) · One of the country's biggest free folk festivals: 60+ performances of world music and dance, food from every direction. Parade of Flags Fri 6:15pm; Sat noon-10pm; Sun noon-6pm. Go early Saturday, park in a garage and walk. source

events.name: Salisbury Beach: Beatlejuice + Fireworks
events.meta: Free · Oceanfront Stage, 1 Ocean Front North, Salisbury · Beatlejuice plays 7:30, fireworks over the water 10:15. Last July fireworks date — next isn't until Aug 8. Arrive before 7 for parking. source

events.name: Yankee Homecoming — Newburyport
events.meta: Mostly free · Nine days kick off Sat: brewfest 5-9pm at Cashman Park (21+ $35 adv, under-21 $5), waterfront concerts nightly from Sun, craft fair, road race Tue Jul 28, fireworks finale. A favorite walkable town at its best. source

events.name: Revolution vs Atlanta United
events.meta: Ticketed, from ~$30 · Gillette Stadium · Post-World Cup soccer fix for Dave & Alex; also Toronto FC Wed Jul 22, 7:30pm (Pride night). Family-friendly Fan Zone before kickoff. source

events.name: Lynch Park Summer Concert: North Shore Roots Band
events.meta: Free, parking $25 weekend · 55 Ober St, Beverly · North Shore Roots Band in the shell at the family's favorite oceanfront park; bring chairs and a picnic. source

events.name: Cinderella at Prescott Park
events.meta: Suggested gate donation · 105 Marcy St, Portsmouth NH · Outdoor waterfront musical, blanket seating; Sat Jul 25 adds a 1pm ASL matinee. Runs through Aug 9 — KK and Isabella's show. source

events.name: SoWa Open Market
events.meta: Free entry · 500 Harrison Ave, Boston · 100+ makers, food trucks, farmers market, vintage — a natural Stacey city day with a South End walk. source

events.name: Boston Landmarks Orchestra — season opener
events.meta: Free · DCR Hatch Shell, Esplanade · 25th-anniversary opener "Best of Boston." Blankets, picnic, chairs rentable; free Wednesdays through Aug 12. Rain date Thursday. source

events.name: Maine Lobster Festival — Rockland
events.meta: Ticketed grounds · 79th year: lobster every way, the Great Crate Race, the parade, live music on the bay. Full-day-plus trip. source

events.name: Beverly Homecoming + LobsterFest at Lynch Park
events.meta: Mostly free · Beverly · Expanded citywide celebration for Beverly's 400th: live music, movies, road race, fireworks. LobsterFest under the tent at Lynch Park Wed Aug 5 — the family-favorite park, so grab tickets early. source
